title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary:
# ORACLE EVENING BRIEF

Bitcoin holding steady at 73,969—modest gains today but the real story's the sentiment floor. Fear and Greed sitting at 28. That's deep-fear territory, and historically, that's where smart money enters.

Hashrate holding strong at 977 exahashes. Network's secure, miners aren't panicking despite margin pressure.

Mempool's flush with 91k transactions but fees remain rational—two sat per byte for fastest confirmation. No congestion stress, which tells you volume isn't froth
